findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "mcp_connect" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Initiate a connection to an MCP server. For OAuth servers, returns an authorization URL to open in a browser.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: mcp_connect · Private data: skill_files, skill_upload, skill_view · Public sink: skill_upload · Destructive: app_run, knowledge_delete, mcp_disconnect, mcp_run.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: mcp_connect · Private data: skill_files, skill_upload, skill_view · Public sink: skill_upload · Destructive: app_run, knowledge_delete, mcp_disconnect, mcp_run

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
